name: Edmund Burke Foundation
summary: A Washington-based foundation led by Yoram Hazony that runs the National Conservatism (NatCon) conferences, held since 2019 in Washington, London, Rome, Orlando, Miami, Brussels and elsewhere. Billed speakers have included JD Vance, Josh Hawley, Marco Rubio, Peter Thiel, Tucker Carlson, Giorgia Meloni, Ron DeSantis and Viktor Orbán.
